clauses.clause: • Slagstorm deals 3 damage to each creature.
• Slagstorm deals 3 damage to each player.

mapping.notes: Choose(count 1): Cinderclasm's 'each creature' damage (3); the each-opponent damage shape over Zone(PLAYER, ANY), every player (3). The probe plays both modes.

clauses.evidence: [cast modes=[0]] shows only damage to creatures and [cast modes=[1]] only damage to players: one mode per cast. Pack D07_1 (passes): it is a sorcery, refused on the opponent's turn ('window:not_your_turn').

clauses.clause: • Slagstorm deals 3 damage to each creature.
clauses.evidence: [cast modes=[0]] 'you_bear / you_giant / opp_flier / opp_tapped / opp_bear / opp_giant is dealt 3 damage (by card/DEAL_DAMAGE)': every creature, both sides, exactly 3; the 4/4s end with 'damage 0 -> 3' and survive, the others die; no damage to relics, charms or players; 'after the turn ends: damage 3 -> 0'.

clauses.clause: • Slagstorm deals 3 damage to each player.
clauses.evidence: [cast modes=[1]] events 'you is dealt 3 damage' and 'opp is dealt 3 damage'; changes 'opp: life 20 -> 17' and 'you: life 20 -> 17'; no creature touched. Pack D07_2 (passes, three players): all three players, the caster included, lose 3.
